description:
Fetch the full content of a single JobMojito documentation page.

Accepts a URL returned by `search_documentation`. For developer docs the
clean Markdown (.md) variant is fetched automatically. Only
developer.jobmojito.com and help.jobmojito.com URLs are allowed.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

max_chars.description: Truncate content to this many characters (default 20000).

name: get_documentation
title: Read a JobMojito documentation page
